In this town, everybody is out partying.
Once, somebody found a nice rock.
While they are partying all the way out there,
I am in here, preparing for a job interview.
I do not eat breakfast. I wrap it.
The cat is fine. The cat is warm.
My neighbor has a party every single night.
Come out, he says. You only live once.
Fold. Tuck. Roll. Two seconds. One second.
I stopped being able to see my own hands.
The manager put one burger on the counter. Whenever you are ready.
So was his clipboard. And his tie.
He was impressed. Then he asked one question.
I have never cooked a burger. I have never even eaten a burger. I only wrap.
I did not get the job.
The letter said: thank you for wrapping my tie.
So tonight, while they are partying out there, I am back in here, learning to cook.
I put the whole cookbook into Unspool. Now it is reels and quizzes.
You are hired. When can you start?
My first shift was Saturday night. The biggest party of the year.
At midnight, the whole town walked in hungry.
The mayor stared at me. How did you do that?
I said: while you were out partying.
